description: QDay Pay Agent — an autonomous scheduled-payment treasury agent for QoreChain testnet (diana). Payments run inside a scoped EVM authorisation window; the treasury is a protocol-level abstract account whose on-chain spending rules bound the agent's authenticator key. Every window / cross-VM message is authenticated with hybrid signatures (secp256k1 + ML-DSA-87).
name: qday-pay-agent
